title: Who will be the first West Indies bowler to take a five-wicket haul in the opening Test against Pakistan in Tarouba in July 2026?
background: A five-wicket haul means that a bowler takes at least five wickets in a single innings.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Resolve to the first West Indies bowler to reach five wickets in a single innings during the opening Test against Pakistan in Tarouba in July 2026, according to the match scorecard and contemporaneous match reporting.  
       Resolution Date : 2026-07-27  
       Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the bowler's full name.
